facts.text: A seven-foot undead brown skeleton in rusted armor and a mustachioed death mask, dragging a huge greatsword, has appeared in the doorway of Sir Brandon's tomb as the party prepares to leave. The goblins say it is one of the mosaic figures, still alive, and that it killed many of their friends; the slime says it is undead and very mad.
Is the undead giant swordsman Alfred, the shaggy giant with a greatsword who was Sir Brandon's companion in the mosaics?
